population: ESPN WCBB Division I-competing teams matched to season-specific supplied SDV membership plus documented official exceptions; not independently certified NCAA roster completeness
percentile_method: 100 * average rank / n among exact eligible reference members; ties averaged; no ranking of ineligible or vintage-mismatched observations

usage.direction: Context only; higher is not better

ast40.unit: Provider AST_40; per-40 label, denominator not independently verified
ast40.direction: Statistical comparison only; confirm source rate definition

reb40.unit: Provider REB_40; per-40 label, denominator not independently verified
reb40.direction: Statistical comparison only; confirm source rate definition

ftr.direction: Context dependent; higher is not universally better

tov.direction: Higher percentile means more turnovers; lower may be favorable

assisted_rate.direction: Creation context only; higher is not better

fingerprint_off_per100.direction: Higher modeled contribution; requires film validation

fingerprint_def_per100.direction: Higher modeled contribution; requires film validation

fingerprint_total_per100.direction: Higher modeled contribution; no composite added

strength_interpretation: Positive source Net Points contributions and >=75th relative percentile are model-based film-review candidates, not independently verified basketball strengths. Other high percentiles are statistical distinctions only. No overlapping skills are summed.
historical_policy: Separate versioned full-source re-extraction; suppress cohort metrics if metric, identity, position or exposure differs from this reference vintage. Never replace frozen baseline.

membership_policy.unknown_membership: Exclude from D1 universe; do not assign D2 or D3 without evidence
